title: 第341章 聚餐第340章 热闹
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: “热闹？”
赵归涯端着酒杯，金色的横瞳隔着粉纱扫了一眼笑成一团的赵惊昼，无奈摇头。
“那可不是一般的热闹，嗨，说多了都是泪。”
赵归涯说这话时，语气里带着一股‘过来人’的沧桑，配上他那张年轻的脸，反差感拉满，惹得众人又是一阵笑。
随着大家都深入交流，都放松了下来，欧阳叙白和沈言澈都和龙颜喝一块去了。
龙颜端着酒杯，桃花眼里漾着几分醉意，跟欧阳叙白碰了一下，豪气万丈：“来，干了干了，难得不用写报告的日子，不醉不归！”
欧阳叙白被她这股子豪迈劲儿感染，仰头一饮而尽，亮出杯底，打了个酒嗝：“爽！”
凤璟坐在一旁，看着龙颜那副豪饮的模样，嘴角弯了弯，没拦着，只是默默把酒坛往自己这边挪了半寸，免得她喝得太急。
赵归涯靠在椅子上，眼神扫过满院热闹，目光最后落在楚安芷身上。
她坐在他身侧，手里端着茶杯，没有参与到那些觥筹交错中去，只是安静地看着众人笑闹，嘴角挂着一抹浅浅的弧度。
赵归涯看了她一会儿，忽然凑过来，声音压得很低：“想什么呢？”
楚安芷侧眸看他，那抹浅浅的弧度没有变，只是眼底的光微微深了几分：“在想，你以前在维护局的时候，是不是也这样。”
赵归涯愣了一下，随即挑了挑眉：“哪样？”
“被一群人围着闹。”楚安芷的目光从他脸上移开，落在正跟欧阳叙白划拳的龙颜身上，“被学生气，被同事坑，被上司骂……然后下了班，找个人喝喝酒，吐吐槽，第二天继续上班。”
赵归涯沉默了片刻，然后轻笑一声，那笑声很轻，像是从喉咙深处溢出来的，带着几分自己也说不清道不明的情绪。
“差不多吧。”他端起酒杯，抿了一口，声音淡淡的，“不过以前喝酒的时候，身边坐的不是你。”
楚安芷握着茶杯的手微微一顿，没有说话。
赵归涯也没再说什么，只是靠在椅子上，仰头看着暮色渐深的天空，金色的横瞳在粉纱下泛着淡淡的光，像两颗被薄云遮住的星星。
院子里，划拳的声音、碰杯的声音、笑闹的声音混在一起，在暮色中织成一幅人间烟火的画卷。
赵惊昼端着酒杯，跟宋朝生碰了一下，宋朝生依旧是那副话不多的模样，但嘴角的弧度怎么都压不下去，喝了一口酒，目光落在赵惊昼身上，像是怎么也看不够。
白望舒不知什么时候被白恒和白鹤拉进了酒局，脸上已经泛起了薄红，话也比平时多了不少，正跟白恒争论着什么，白恒一脸无奈地听着，白鹤在旁边笑得直拍桌子。
叶知秋和封无痕端着酒杯，坐在角落里低声交谈，偶尔看一眼那边闹成一团的年轻人，脸上带着几分‘过来人’的淡然。
花无忧和赵遇鹤并肩坐着，两人之间没有太多言语，只是偶尔对视一眼，那眼神里藏着的东西，比酒还浓。
叶未央和盘逍端着酒杯，时不时的是这话，目光在众人之间游移，像是聊着八卦。
陈屿堂、裴书臣、沈言澈、秦羽、欧阳叙白几个已经彻底放飞了自我，跟龙颜划拳的划拳、拼酒的拼酒，闹得不亦乐乎。
欧阳清欢、柳清晏、柳清漪和温觉夏畅聊着未来梦想。
凤璟坐在龙颜身边，时不时伸手扶一下她摇晃的身子，面色温润如常，但那双眼睛里漾着的笑意，比平时深了几分。
欧阳叙白又输了一局，被罚了一杯酒，喝完之后整个人都晃了，靠在椅子上，仰头看着天空，忽然冒出一句：“哎，你们说，要是每天都能这样，该多好。”
这句话不大，却让院子里热闹的声音微微顿了一下。
content_en:
"Lively?"
Zhao Guiya was holding the wine glass, his golden eyes glanced at Zhao Jingzhou who was smiling through the pink gauze, and he shook his head helplessly.
"That's not an ordinary lively scene. Hey, I'll be in tears if I talk about it too much."
When Zhao Guiya said this, there was a sense of "experienced experience" in his tone, which, coupled with his young face, was full of contrast and made everyone laugh again.
As everyone communicated in depth and relaxed, Ouyang Xubai and Shen Yanche went to drink with Long Yan.
Long Yan was holding the wine glass, with a hint of drunkenness in her peach blossom eyes. She touched it with Ouyang Xubai and said proudly, "Come on, let's do it. It's a rare day when I don't have to write a report. I won't come back until I'm drunk!"
Ouyang Xubai was infected by her heroic spirit. He raised his head and drank it all in one gulp. He showed the bottom of the glass and burped: "It's great!"
Feng Jing sat aside and looked at Long Yan's drinking appearance. She curved her mouth and did not stop him. She just silently moved the wine jar half an inch towards her to prevent her from drinking too hastily.
Zhao Guiya leaned on the chair, his eyes swept across the bustling courtyard, and finally landed on Chu Anzhi.
She sat next to him, holding a tea cup in her hand, and did not participate in the exchange of drinks. She just watched the people laughing quietly, with a slight arc at the corner of her mouth.
Zhao Guiya looked at her for a while, then suddenly came over and asked in a very low voice, "What are you thinking about?"
Chu Anzhi looked at him sideways, the shallow arc did not change, but the light in her eyes became slightly darker: "I was wondering if you were like this when you were in the maintenance bureau."
Zhao Guiya was stunned for a moment, then raised his eyebrows: "What kind?"
"Being surrounded by a group of people." Chu Anzhi's eyes moved away from his face and landed on Long Yan, who was fistfighting with Ouyang Xubai. "I was angry with students, cheated by colleagues, scolded by my boss... Then after work, I found someone to drink and complain, and then continued to work the next day."
Zhao Guiya was silent for a moment, and then chuckled. The laughter was very soft, as if overflowing from the depths of his throat, with some emotions that he couldn't explain.
"Absolutely." He picked up the wine glass, took a sip, and said in a calm voice, "But when I was drinking before, the person sitting next to me was not you."
Chu Anzhi's hand holding the tea cup paused slightly and said nothing.
Zhao Guiya didn't say anything else, he just leaned on the chair and looked up at the darkening sky. His golden horizontal pupils glowed faintly under the pink gauze, like two stars covered by thin clouds.
In the yard, the sounds of fist pumps, clinking glasses, and laughter mixed together to form a picture of human fireworks in the dusk.
Zhao Jingzhou held the wine glass and clinked it with Song Chaosheng. Song Chaosheng still looked like he didn't talk much, but he couldn't suppress the curvature of the corners of his mouth. He took a sip of wine and his eyes fell on Zhao Jingzhou, as if he couldn't get enough of it.
Bai Wangshu was dragged into the wine bureau by Bai Heng and Bai He at some point. His face had turned red and he was talking a lot more than usual. He was arguing with Bai Heng. Bai Heng listened helplessly, while Bai He laughed so hard that he hit the table.
Ye Zhiqiu and Feng Wuhen were holding wine glasses and sitting in the corner talking quietly. Occasionally they glanced at the young people making a fuss over there, with a somewhat "experienced" indifference on their faces.
Hua Wuyou and Zhao Yuhe sat side by side. There were not many words between them. They only looked at each other occasionally. There was something hidden in those eyes that was stronger than wine.
Ye Weiyang and Pan Xiao were holding wine glasses, saying this from time to time, their eyes wandering among the people, as if chatting about gossip.
Chen Yutang, Pei Shuchen, Shen Yanche, Qin Yu, and Ouyang Xubai had completely let themselves go, and they were having a lot of fun with Long Yan, punching each other, and drinking.
Ouyang Qinghuan, Liu Qingyan, Liu Qingyi and Wen Juexia Chang chatted about their future dreams.
Feng Jing sat next to Long Yan, reaching out to support her swaying body from time to time. Her face was as gentle as usual, but the smile in her eyes was a little deeper than usual.
Ouyang Xubai lost another game and was fined a glass of wine. After drinking, he was shaking. He leaned on his chair, looked up at the sky, and suddenly said: "Hey, you guys think, it would be great if this could happen every day."
This sentence was not loud, but it made the lively voices in the yard pause slightly.
